firmware.title: September Pixel Drop update available
firmware.description:
Your Pixel is getting better with the latest features and enhancements. Learn more on our Community page.

What's new?

• With Pixel VIPs, call or text from your home screen widget, spot unread messages via glanceable notification badges and easily switch between VIPs using the bottom floating menu.

• Scam Detection for your messaging apps – now in more countries and languages. [1]

• Instantly customise your Pixel with Harry Potter audiobook packs to celebrate the release of Harry Potter: The Full-Cast Audio Editions on Audible. One tap changes your wallpaper, icons and sounds with elements from the audiobooks. [2]


[1] Available only in selected languages and regions.

[2] Harry Potter audiobook packs available until 31 December 2026.
